name: The Excavation of Moss-Crag
flavor: Drop from the elderwood canopy into a goblin strip-mine to uncover what ancient terror the miners struck.

phases.narration: Strapped into Captain Sylva's woven warden-harnesses, you drop through the smoky canopy leaves directly onto the swaying pine scaffolding of Moss-Crag Trench. Below, notched goblin crossbows pivot upward as lookouts screech over the clang of pickaxes.

Descending into the fog of the lower tier, you wade through churning mud flumes where ore-washers dump caustic slag. A feral scrap-hound with rusted teeth snarls from a chained boom, guarding the toxic sludge-boilers.

You break into the floor of the trench. The goblin prospectors were not mining mundane ore: their massive steam cranes have scraped bare the colossal brass bulkhead of an ancient buried war-vault. Chief Sapper Blagg stands atop the steam crane's boom, turning its crushing iron claw toward you.
